jobs.title: Crypto Research Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Crypto Banter is the world’s No. 1 LIVE crypto streaming channel with multiple distribution arms, sharing breaking news and alpha to the world.
jobs.description:
Crypto Banter is the world’s No.1 LIVE crypto streaming channel with multiple distribution arms, sharing breaking news and alpha to the world. What started with two enthusiasts in a coffee shop has evolved into a consortium of the most influential media channels in the industry, accruing over 10M monthly views; and a suite of products built for every stage of the crypto journey. We are a group of misfits and entrepreneurs who work harder than anyone else, fueled by an obsession for what we do. We are on a mission to build the most profitable community in the world.

Crypto Researcher

We are looking for a Crypto Researcher to sit at the heart of our daily content, owning the research that shapes what we say on air and the trade ideas we put in front of our community.

This is a commercially accountable role. Your work directly influences the quality, credibility and tradability of everything we publish. You will be expected to spot narratives before they break, pressure-test ideas with data, and turn raw market noise into clear, actionable insight.

This is a remote-first (based anywhere in the world) role aligned to South African Standard Time (SAST). Given the 24/7 nature of crypto markets, you will need to be comfortable researching outside traditional hours to stay ahead of developments.

What you'll do

  • Track the markets around the clock: Stay informed on global events that could impact markets, with a particular focus on cryptocurrency trends. Keep on top of macroeconomic shifts and how they may influence market movements. Because our markets never sleep, being online and researching outside standard hours is crucial to staying ahead of potential developments.
  • Research with rigour: Critically assess new trends, emerging narratives and trade ideas, employing a logical and data-driven approach. Develop a deep understanding of current market conditions, including ongoing trades, popular narratives and the key news stories that may influence trends.
  • Read market sentiment: Stay on top of the latest industry launches and evolving trends, and conduct sentiment analysis to understand overall market sentiment. Engage actively with various platforms, offering insights and commentary on their usability and potential.
  • Shape the daily shows: Identify the key question or topic of the day, what most people in the community are focused on or curious about. Working as part of the team, curate and design the daily script, documentation and narrative for each daily show, ensuring the utmost quality and professionalism. Be active and prepared for any research-centric calls.
  • Deliver actionable insight Seek out actionable, tradable information that community members can use to make informed decisions and learn from. Contribute research, trade setups and commentary directly to our Discord threads, keeping the community close to your thinking. Implement business suggestions and strategies as the role develops.

Your skills and experience

  • Crypto fluency: A deep, hands on understanding of cryptocurrency markets, narratives and culture supported by 3+ years of experience in a crypto research focused role. You live and breathe this space.
  • Research and analysis: A logical, data driven approach to assessing trends, narratives and trade ideas, with the discipline to separate signal from noise.
  • Macro awareness: Comfortable connecting macroeconomic developments to crypto market movements and explaining why they matter.
  • Sentiment reading: Experience analysing sentiment across social platforms and communities to gauge where the market's attention sits.
  • Communication: Able to turn complex research into clear, concise scripts, documentation and narratives suited to a live audience.
  • Pace and adaptability: You thrive in a fast-moving, 24/7 environment and can flex your hours around the market.

Personal Attributes

  • Genuinely curious and plugged into the crypto community and wider conversation
  • Self-starting and proactive, comfortable owning your own research agenda
  • Calm under pressure and energised by a fast pace
  • A team player who takes pride in the quality of what goes out the door

jobs.title: Head of Crypto Vertical (Business Growth Leader)
jobs.excerpt: About UtorgFounded in 2019, Utorg builds the infrastructure behind stablecoin payments: on/off-ramps, self-custodial wallets, and crypto cards.
jobs.description:
About Utorg

Founded in 2019, Utorg builds the infrastructure behind stablecoin payments: on/off-ramps, self-custodial wallets, and crypto cards. Over 2 million users across 130+ countries already buy, hold, and spend crypto through our app. On the B2B side, the same rails power 2,100+ platforms, with $2.4B+ moved to date.

Fully MiCA-authorized across the EEA. PCI DSS Level 2 certified. Backed by Dragonfly, TA Ventures, and Hypra.

We are an international team of young and ambitious professionals united by a passion for innovation and a belief in the decentralized world. And now, we are looking for a Head of Crypto Vertical who will strengthen our team and contribute to the success of our products and the bright future of Web3.

Mission:

Build and scale the crypto business line (crypto card, non-custodial wallet, trading) into an autonomous, high-growth vertical. Own the P&L and drive revenue, profitability, and sustainable, regulation-aware growth.

What you will do:

  • P&L ownership for the crypto vertical: budgeting, forecasting, pricing, margin management.

  • Partnerships & BD: identify, negotiate, and close strategic deals (issuers/processors, liquidity, payroll/HR SaaS, neobanks, exchanges, aggregators, merchants).

  • Market & regulation: track competitors, user behavior, and rules (KYC/AML/MiCA, card schemes, on/off-ramps) and turn insights into action.

  • Team: own the hiring plan and build a lean business team from zero (growth/performance, BD/partnerships, ops/support). Set clear responsibilities and KPIs, coach for performance, and make tough calls when someone doesn’t deliver.

  • Cross-functional leadership: align Product, Legal/Compliance, Ops, Data, and Marketing around clear commercial targets and SLAs.

  • Reporting: present plans, numbers, and decisions to founders/execs.

First 3–6 months (hands-on):

  1. You’ll run ops yourself, set up the initial processes (pipelines, SLAs, weekly KPIs, monthly P&L), and hire the core business team (growth, BD, ops).

  2. You’ll launch acquisition channels (target LTV/CAC ≥ 3 in one priority segment) along with the CMO and close the first 2–3 strategic B2B/B2B2C deals.

  3. Once ops are stable, you shift even more time to scaling and strategy.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years in fintech/crypto/payments/banking with GM / Head of BizDev / Head of Business-type ownership.

  • Proven P&L delivery on revenue, profit, margin, and volume targets.

  • Hands-on launching/scaling crypto payments/wallets/cards/trading (B2C and B2B/B2B2C).

  • Strong command of unit economics (CAC, LTV, ARPU, margin, payback), pricing, and portfolio prioritization.

  • Deep partnerships/BD track record: sourcing, negotiating, contracting, integrating, and making deals perform.

  • Solid grasp of KYC/AML/MiCA, card-scheme, and on/off-ramp constraints; productive work with Legal/Compliance.

  • Strong analytical skills (SQL/BI a plus) and clear executive communication in English.

What this role is not:

  • This is not a classic product manager or chief product officer role.

What we offer:

  • Established yet dynamic environment: We’re a well-rooted fintech company with several profitable products and structured business units. Historically strong in B2B2C across Europe, we’re now doubling down on building and scaling a consumer-facing crypto vertical

  • Real traction, not just vision: Our non-custodial wallet and crypto card are already live with confirmed product-market fit in multiple segments (with strong revenue and 6-month retention metrics). Crypto IBAN is in development, and trading is at the concept stage. There's still untapped potential in segments we haven’t entered yet.

  • Ownership and autonomy: This role is essentially a mini-CEO position. You’ll have full P&L ownership, a direct line to the founders, and the mandate to build a standalone business unit with a 2+ year strategic horizon. You'll shape product offerings, growth strategy, and go-to-market channels.

  • Hands-on early stage, high leverage long-term: In the first 3–6 months, you’ll build the business team (growth/BD/ops), establish processes (pipeline, SLA, KPI, P&L), and drive predictable growth via performance marketing, brand, sales, and strategic partnerships. From there, it’s all about scale and long-term impact.

  • Resources and support where it matters: You’ll get the budget and resources aligned with your roadmap, autonomy in decision-making, and influence over a broader fintech product portfolio (wallet, card, IBAN, trading) in one of the most promising markets: crypto in the EU.

jobs.title: Chief Crypto Officer (CCO)
jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryThe Chief Crypto Officer (CCO) is responsible for leading the organization's cryptocurrency, blockchain, digital asset, and Web3 strategy.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Chief Crypto Officer (CCO) is responsible for leading the organization's cryptocurrency, blockchain, digital asset, and Web3 strategy. This executive develops and oversees crypto-related products, services, partnerships, regulatory compliance, risk management, and innovation initiatives. The role ensures that the organization remains competitive within the rapidly evolving digital asset ecosystem while maintaining security, governance, and regulatory standards.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute the organization's cryptocurrency and digital asset strategy.
  • Identify emerging opportunities in blockchain, decentralized finance (DeFi), tokenization, stablecoins, and digital asset custody.
  • Advise executive leadership and the Board on crypto market developments and trends.
  • Drive innovation through blockchain-based business models and digital asset solutions.
  • Establish long-term growth plans for crypto-related business lines.

Digital Asset Management

  • Oversee cryptocurrency treasury management and digital asset portfolios.
  • Develop policies governing the acquisition, custody, transfer, and storage of digital assets.
  • Monitor market conditions and recommend asset allocation strategies.
  • Ensure robust wallet management and digital asset security protocols.

Product & Business Development

  • Lead development of crypto-enabled products and services.
  • Identify strategic partnerships with exchanges, custodians, blockchain networks, and fintech providers.
  • Evaluate opportunities for tokenization, smart contracts, NFTs, and decentralized applications (dApps).
  • Support go-to-market strategies for blockchain and digital asset initiatives.

Regulatory Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure compliance with applicable cryptocurrency regulations, AML/KYC requirements, sanctions screening, and financial crime prevention measures.
  • Monitor global regulatory developments impacting digital assets.
  • Work closely with Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Audit teams.
  • Establish governance frameworks for blockchain and crypto operations.

Risk Management

  • Develop enterprise-wide digital asset risk management policies.
  • Oversee cybersecurity controls related to blockchain infrastructure and digital assets.
  • Assess operational, market, liquidity, custody, and counterparty risks.
  • Implement fraud prevention and incident response procedures.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Represent the organization in industry forums, regulatory discussions, and blockchain communities.
  • Build relationships with regulators, technology providers, investors, and industry associations.
  • Provide thought leadership on digital assets and blockchain innovation.

Team Leadership

  • Build and lead high-performing crypto, blockchain, and digital asset teams.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, compliance, and operational excellence.
  • Mentor executives and technical leaders involved in crypto initiatives.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Master's degree preferred.
  • Professional certifications in blockchain, digital assets, cybersecurity, or financial services are advantageous.

Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in financial services, fintech, blockchain, cryptocurrency, digital assets, or technology sectors.
  • Proven experience managing crypto products, blockchain platforms, or digital asset operations.
  • Strong understanding of cryptocurrency markets, blockchain technologies, and Web3 ecosystems.
  • Experience working with regulators and compliance frameworks related to digital assets.

Technical Knowledge

  • Blockchain protocols and infrastructure.
  • Cryptocurrency trading and custody solutions.
  • Smart contracts and tokenization platforms.
  • Digital wallets and key management systems.
  • DeFi, stablecoins, CBDCs, and emerging digital asset technologies.
  • AML/KYC and financial crime compliance.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic Vision & Innovation
  • Digital Asset Expertise
  • Regulatory & Compliance Leadership
  • Risk Management
  • Financial Acumen
  • Technology Leadership
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Change Management
  • Executive Communication
  • Decision Making
  • Team Leadership

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Growth in crypto-related revenue and assets under management.
  • Successful launch of blockchain and digital asset products.
  • Regulatory compliance and audit outcomes.
  • Reduction in digital asset security incidents.
  • Strategic partnership development.
  • Customer adoption of crypto-enabled services.
  • Risk management effectiveness.
  • Operational efficiency of crypto platforms.

jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist (Fintech & Crypto Payments)
jobs.excerpt: About the ClientWe're helping a company in the fintech and digital assets industry find an experienced Customer Support Specialist to support users of its digital assets platform and associated crypto payment card.
jobs.description:
About the Client

We're helping a company in the fintech and digital assets industry find an experienced Customer Support Specialist to support users of its digital assets platform and associated crypto payment card.

The company operates within the evolving financial technology space, providing digital financial solutions that connect traditional payment services with cryptocurrency and digital assets.

As the business continues to grow, they're looking for their first dedicated Customer Support Specialist to take ownership of incoming customer inquiries, resolve issues, and help establish a reliable, high-quality customer support function.

The Role

We're looking for a Customer Support Specialist – Fintech & Crypto Payments who combines excellent customer service skills with a strong understanding of financial products, digital platforms, payment transactions, and ideally cryptocurrency.

You'll be the first point of contact for customers using the platform and its associated crypto card, helping them navigate account setup, verification, platform functionality, card usage, payments, deposits, withdrawals, and other transaction-related concerns.

The majority of support will be handled through live chat and written communication, with occasional phone or video calls when customers require more hands-on assistance.

As the first person joining this function, you'll be expected to take ownership of incoming cases and resolve issues independently wherever possible, following established SOPs and escalation procedures.

This is not a generic customer service role. We're looking for someone who can understand the product, investigate problems, identify solutions, and confidently guide customers through financial and technical issues.

Role Details

Commitment: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Working Hours: Fixed Bahamas business hours (Eastern Time)

Location: Fully Remote

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Start Date: ASAP

Monthly Rate: US$1,200 - $1,600 (Depending on level of experience)

What You'll Do

Customer Support & Platform Assistance

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for incoming customer inquiries through live chat, email, and other written channels.

  • Handle phone or video calls when issues require more detailed or personalized assistance.

  • Guide customers through account creation, onboarding, verification, and general platform navigation.

  • Help customers understand and use the platform's features and services effectively.

  • Investigate customer concerns, identify underlying issues, and provide accurate, timely resolutions.

  • Take ownership of cases from initial contact through resolution, escalating only when necessary and in line with established SOPs.

  • Maintain professional, clear, and reassuring communication throughout the customer journey.

Crypto Card & Payment Support

  • Assist customers with crypto card issuance, activation, linking, and usage.

  • Troubleshoot Visa card-related issues, including declined or failed transactions, card connections, and payment concerns.

  • Help customers understand transaction statuses, payment processes, and common reasons for unsuccessful transactions.

  • Support customers with deposits, withdrawals, transfers, balances, and account-related transactions.

  • Investigate transaction discrepancies and coordinate with internal teams where additional support is required.

  • Provide clear guidance while maintaining accuracy when handling financial and transactional information.

Account Verification & Issue Resolution

  • Guide customers through relevant KYC, identity verification, and account-related procedures.

  • Troubleshoot common account access, verification, and platform issues.

  • Independently investigate and resolve incoming cases using available tools, resources, and established procedures.

  • Recognize when issues require escalation to operations, compliance, payments, or technical teams.

  • Maintain ownership of the customer experience even when other teams are involved in resolving a case.

  • Handle sensitive customer information with appropriate care, discretion, and confidentiality.

Support Operations & Continuous Improvement

  • Accurately document customer inquiries, troubleshooting steps, actions taken, and resolutions in internal systems.

  • Follow established SOPs while identifying opportunities to improve support processes and customer communication.

  • Help build and refine the customer support function as the company's first dedicated support specialist.

  • Identify recurring issues, customer pain points, and potential gaps in the platform experience.

  • Share feedback and recommendations with relevant internal teams.

  • Stay informed about platform functionality, crypto card processes, internal procedures, and product updates.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • At least 3 years of experience in customer support, client services, or client operations, preferably within fintech, financial services, digital banking, payments, or cryptocurrency.

  • Direct experience supporting customers using financial products, payment cards, or digital financial platforms.

  • Strong understanding of card payments and common transaction issues, including declined payments, failed transactions, card activation, and payment troubleshooting.

  • Familiarity with customer onboarding, account verification, KYC, and transaction-related support processes.

  • Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to explain financial or technical issues clearly and professionally.

  • Experience handling customer inquiries through live chat, email, or other written communication channels.

  • Confidence communicating with customers through phone or video calls when required.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to independently investigate and resolve customer concerns.

  • Ability to follow SOPs, exercise sound judgment, and recognize when escalation is necessary.

  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when dealing with financial transactions and sensitive customer information.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple incoming cases while maintaining quality and responsiveness.

  • A proactive, resourceful, and customer-focused approach to problem-solving.

  • Familiarity with cryptocurrency and digital assets, whether through professional experience or personal use.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Professional experience supporting a cryptocurrency exchange, wallet provider, crypto card, trading platform, or digital assets business.

  • Experience supporting Visa/Mastercard-linked financial products or payment cards.

  • Familiarity with cryptocurrency wallets, exchanges, deposits, withdrawals, and on-chain transactions.

  • Experience in payments operations, trading operations, financial-services operations, or client operations.

  • Experience supporting B2C financial products.

  • Familiarity with customer support platforms such as Intercom, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Salesforce, or similar tools.

  • Experience using ticketing systems, knowledge bases, and internal escalation workflows.

  • Understanding of blockchain and cryptocurrency concepts.

  • Experience coordinating with compliance, risk, fraud, payments, or technical teams.

  • Previous experience helping establish or improve a customer support function.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You're someone who genuinely enjoys helping customers but also has the technical curiosity and financial-product knowledge needed to investigate and resolve problems.

You're comfortable explaining how digital financial platforms work, guiding customers through account and transaction issues, and troubleshooting payment card concerns. You don't simply pass difficult questions to another team—you investigate, follow the appropriate procedures, and take ownership of the issue through to resolution.

Ideally, you've worked professionally within a crypto or digital assets environment. However, we're also open to strong candidates from fintech, digital banking, or payments who have a solid understanding of cryptocurrency through personal use.

As the first dedicated customer support hire, you're comfortable working independently, following established processes, and helping shape how the function develops.

Most importantly, you're resourceful, detail-oriented, calm under pressure, and committed to delivering an excellent customer experience.

Why Join?

  • Join a growing business operating at the intersection of fintech, digital assets, and payment technology.

  • Become the company's first dedicated Customer Support Specialist and play an important role in developing the function.

  • Gain hands-on exposure to digital financial products, crypto cards, payment processes, and platform operations.

  • Take meaningful ownership of customer cases rather than working within a narrowly defined support function.

  • Collaborate directly with operations, compliance, payments, and technical teams.

  • Work remotely in a role that values independence, initiative, and problem-solving.

Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Interview with Bamboo Works

  2. Client Interview

  3. Offer & Onboarding

jobs.excerpt: Who We Are:Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

Alpaca's product team is looking for a Product Manager to own Alpaca's regulated crypto trading and yield surface: spot or perps exchange, fiat and stablecoin funding rails, staking / lending and the crypto API that partners build on.

You will partner deeply with engineering, compliance, legal, partnerships, and the broader Alpaca product team to ship regulated crypto infrastructure at scale. You will help shape and grow the crypto product itself, and you will be expected to provide early signal on US policy changes rather than react after rules formalize.

Things You Get To Do:

  • Own the spot crypto exchange product surface - pair coverage, order types, availability in various jurisdictions and the partner facing experience for trading crypto on Alpaca.
  • Lead integrations that unlock funding and liquidity with LPs and custodians. Own the stablecoin funding flow, including paths for USDC and other regulated / GENIUS-aligned stables.
  • Work with partners to understand crypto needs for fintechs, neobrokers, and institutional platforms. Expand supported networks and coins that balances partner demand and custody readiness.
  • Drive staking and lending / earn product design within regulatory and ops constraints.
  • Shape a crypto API surface that treats developers and agents as primary customers: SDKs, reference integrations, changelog discipline.
  • Lead and execute the product case for crypto perps.

Who You Are (Must Haves):

  • Excited about what Alpaca is building and ready to own a core regulated crypto product surface.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, finance, or equivalent.
  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Engineering, and/or starting a startup, preferably within crypto exchanges, brokerage, market making, custody, or financial infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated depth on at least one core crypto product surface at production scale: spot trading / exchange, custody / wallets, fiat or stablecoin funding rails, staking / earn or derivatives / perps.
  • Strong understanding of crypto market structure - order books, liquidity providers, spreads, slippage, settlement, and how B2B / API-first platforms differ from retail-only exchanges.
  • Experience shipping in a regulated environment alongside Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Operations - comfortable with ambiguity and real-time tradeoffs.
  • Proven ability to run partner / customer discovery and turn it into a prioritized roadmap; excellent written and verbal communication across engineering and executive audiences.
  • Business acumen to weigh ROI, partner demand, regulatory risk, tech feasibility, time, and budget.
  • AI-native PM workflow; AI is part of your daily stack in getting work done.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Direct experience at a crypto exchange, broker-dealer, custodian, market maker, or institutional crypto infrastructure provider.
  • Experience building developer-facing crypto APIs used by quants, algo traders, or automated / agentic systems.
  • Familiarity with staking, lending / earn, perpetual futures, and the operational and regulatory constraints of offering them through a licensed entity.
  • Background combining regulated financial-product context (broker-dealer, payments, custody) with crypto native infrastructure (wallets, L1/L2, on-chain settlement).

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.
